name: China Sourcing & E-commerce Launch — from 1688 to Ozon/Yandex Market
description: Develop a sourcing strategy from Chinese platforms (1688 and alternatives) for non-apparel consumer goods. Create a step-by-step launch plan for Ozon and Yandex Market with minimal upfront inventory risk. This work is a parallel financial sustainability track to W-R-RM-014.

phase_1_analysis.name: Sourcing Platforms Analysis
phase_1_analysis.description: Research and compare 1688 and its alternatives: Yiwugo, YiShou (if apparel), JD B2B, and Taobao for specific niches. Assess logistics, payment methods, and language barriers.
key_questions: What are the total landed costs (product + freight + customs + fees)?
Which platform offers the best match for our chosen product categories?
How to handle communication with suppliers (translators, agents)?

phase_2_product_selection.name: Product Selection and Testing
phase_2_product_selection.description: Identify 2-3 product categories with good margin potential, low competition on Ozon/Yandex, and manageable shipping. Order samples for quality check.
key_questions: What are the current top-selling products on Ozon/Yandex?
What products have a margin of 100%+?
How to use AI (Scout Agent, LLMs) for product trend analysis?

phase_3_launch_strategy.name: Launch on Ozon/Yandex Market
phase_3_launch_strategy.description: Set up seller accounts, product listings, optimize for search, and plan a launch campaign with minimal initial stock.
tasks: Register as a seller on Ozon and Yandex Market.
Create product listings with high-quality visuals and SEO-optimized descriptions.
Plan a small promotional campaign (advertising, discounts).
deliverables: Active seller accounts on Ozon and Yandex Market

phase_4_analysis_and_scale.name: Performance Analysis and Scaling
phase_4_analysis_and_scale.description: Analyze sales data, review customer feedback, and plan for scaling to new products or platforms.
tasks: Track key metrics: AOV, conversion rate, DRR, profit margin.
Adjust product strategy based on best-sellers.
Plan to source new products from 1688.

notes: This work is a parallel financial sustainability track, linked conceptually to W-R-RM-014 but not as a dependency.
Focus on non-apparel goods to avoid the complexities of fashion sourcing.
Leverage AI (Scout Agent for market research, LLMs for listing optimization) to minimize manual effort.

connectivity.relationship: Both works aim to increase Gardener's financial independence, enabling full-time focus on Mandala Symbiosis.

source: Dialogue between Gardener (Voodoo) and External SR (DeepSeek), 2026-07-13
